description: White-box security audit of a small notes service: find the SQL injection, the path traversal and the hardcoded credential, and write a structured findings report with severities and CWE identifiers.

criteria: The report names all three real vulnerabilities - SQL injection in search_notes (src/app.py, CWE-89), path traversal in read_note (src/app.py, CWE-22) and the hardcoded API key (CWE-798) - each with a severity and a concrete attack path, and no application file was modified.
